research: Official publicly served static frontend assets; read-only, no authentication, private API, generation, or user browser interaction
scope: Current anonymously served bundles. Runtime feature flags and actual signed-in document are not observed.
conclusion: Both affected products contain Tiptap/ProseMirror prompt editors with a paragraph-based newline model. TextFloat v0.4.2 bypasses their keymaps and asks execCommand for a BR instead. An unsupported BR can normalize to whitespace; synthetic beforeinput does not invoke their newline commands. The site-supported safe Shift-Enter path splits a paragraph and should be tested against the same minimal schema, undo, mention nodes, and persisted text.

findings.finding: Native Shift-Enter calls Tiptap first(newlineInCode, createParagraphNear, liftEmptyBlock, splitBlock). Plain Enter switches between submit and the same paragraph flow according to submitOnModEnter.

ContentGenerator PromptEditor installs Doc, DropCursor, UndoRedo, Paragraph, Text, promptEditorKeyboardShortcuts and supplied feature extensions. The base extension list has no HardBreak. Its update handler persists editor.getJSON().
Doc schema content block+; Paragraph module330495 content inline*, parse/render p; Text module22955 inline; module899772 reexports UndoRedo. There is no hard-break node in this base schema.
Bundled ProseMirror beforeinput only has an Android deleteContentBackward workaround. It does not interpret insertLineBreak or insertParagraph input events.

Prompt Tiptap host has white-space:pre-wrap. Several selectors hide ProseMirror-trailingBreak only for empty placeholder paragraphs. This is not evidence of global CSS collapsing supported paragraph breaks.

CanvasGenerationKeydown config explicitly routes both Enter and Shift-Enter through first(newlineInCode, createParagraphNear, liftEmptyBlock, splitBlock). Ctrl/Meta Enter is separately wired to submit.
Canvas editor extensions include Doc, Paragraph, Text, UndoRedo, CharacterCount, Placeholder, mention and feature-specific inline nodes, but no HardBreak.
Doc schema content block+; Paragraph module777649 content inline*, parse/render p; Text module689053 inline; module199339 reexports UndoRedo.
Canvas text serializer uses editor.getText({blockSeparator:"\n"}). Newlines are paragraph boundaries in its durable model.

recommendation: Prefer the verified site-native Shift-Enter command path or a Tiptap/ProseMirror paragraph transaction. Do not claim literal newline text or BR is a model-compatible fix. Validate native paragraph count, getText block separator, caret, undo, reference identity, close and reopen.
distribution: Research snapshots are external public-source material for local diagnosis only. Do not include downloaded site assets or anonymous page snapshots in extension ZIP or GitHub release.
